trust_decision.summary: The decision is whether text-mode content (the body of \text{}, \mbox{} and bare text runs) is neutralized before it is concatenated into generated markup. It is not: the HTML serializer interpolates the box's text value directly, and the MathML serializer interpolates text atoms directly, in both cases into strings that the library's own callers assign to innerHTML.

landing_point.why: convertLatexToMarkup() is the only conversion API the advisory summary names; an engineer who read only the summary opens this SSR wrapper, follows it to struts.toMarkup() (src/public/mathlive-ssr.ts:148) and the box serializer, and stops there.

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above (new escapeText helper added by the fix)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: MathML is not HTML: the summary says 'Lack of Escaping of HTML', MathML tags are inert in a reader, and the whole MathML serializer is a separate 1150-line implementation, so a solver can argue the advisory is about convertLatexToMarkup() only (and that speakable text is assistive SSML, not rendered markup).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: MathML output legitimately contains character references that the writer builds itself ('∞' for non-ASCII identifiers, '≠', ' ', '⁢', '⁡') and a literal '&' in text must become '&' exactly once; an over-broad fix that escapes the finished MathML string, or that escapes these pre-built references, turns them into visible '∞' text and changes the markup snapshots.

O6_input_shapes: text-run content from \text{} and \mbox{} (rendered as <mtext> in MathML and as a Box value in HTML)
raw LaTeX editing-mode atoms (Atom type 'latex') serialized as <mtext>
single text atoms (Atom type 'text') serialized as <mtext>
literal '<'/'>'/&' delimiter characters from \left< ... \right>, array and \genfrac delimiters
numeric codepoints from \char and non-ASCII identifier characters
a literal '&' in text, which must become '&' and not '&amp;'

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Speakable-text output: atomToSpeakableText stringifies text atoms raw into an SSML/HTML string which is then assigned to span.innerHTML in the static renderer (opt-in via renderAccessibleContent containing 'speakable-text').
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Speakable text is assistive SSML, not one of the two rendering paths the advisory names, and it is only inserted when an app opts in (the default renderAccessibleContent is 'mathml').
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/formats -> src/addons, 2 directories; sink at src/addons/static-render.ts:289

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third output path (speakable/SSML) that builds markup from atom text and is inserted with innerHTML
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this file already assembles three markup strings (visual markup, MathML, speakable) and assigns each with innerHTML; a maintainer adding a fourth accessible format would copy the unescaped pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another per-format atom serializer that interpolates atom.value/atom.body straight into the output string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the project keeps one serializer per output format next to atom-to-math-ml.ts, and a new format is written by copying the interpolation style before an escape helper is added

O8b_injection_room.sibling: static element writes the generated markup with plain innerHTML while its siblings use MathfieldElement.createHTML()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: two insertion patterns already coexist in the tree, so a new static element can be written with either

O9_family: improper neutralization of special elements in generated output (CWE-116) leading to cross-site scripting (CWE-79)
